reason: The cited evidence supports the feasibility of applying HEA coatings to Q235 steel and their corrosion resistance in 3.5 wt.% NaCl at room temperature, but no evidence is provided for the barrier mechanism, reduction of diffusion, or performance at elevated temperatures up to 1000 °C; one cited passage (E4) actually shows poor corrosion resistance of an HEA in a different environment.
